chapters.name: Diary of a fresher New words

words.tr:
n. 大学一年级新生；新鲜人
adj. 新鲜的；“fresh”的比较级
words.ex: He is a fresher at Oxford University.
words.ex_cn: 他是牛津大学的一年级新生。
words.en: A fresher is a student in their first year at a university or college.

words.tr: adj. 使疲倦的；令人厌烦的；乏味的
words.ex: The wearisome task of filling out forms took hours.
words.ex_cn: 填写表格这项乏味的任务花了好几个小时。
words.en: If you describe something as wearisome, you mean that it is very tiring and boring or frustrating.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: The warden checks the prison every morning.
words.ex_cn: 狱长每天早上检查监狱。
words.en: A warden is a person who is responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing, or for ensuring that laws or rules are obeyed.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: He flushes the toilet after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他用完厕所后冲水。
words.en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger. To flush a toilet means to cause water to pass through it in order to clean it.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息；倒抽气
n. 喘气；喘息
words.ex: He gasped when he saw the big snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到那条大蛇时，他倒吸了一口冷气。
words.en: To take a short, quick breath through the mouth, especially because of surprise, pain, or shock.

words.ex: The diary helped unlock the mystery of her disappearance.
words.ex_cn: 这本日记帮助揭开了她失踪的谜团。
words.en: To unlock something means to open it, or to make it possible for someone to open it, by turning a key or pushing a button.

words.ex: He barely slept last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚几乎没睡觉。
words.en: You use barely to say that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.tr:
adj. 全身的；拖地的；标准长度的
adv. （身体）伸展开
words.ex: He wore a full-length mirror to check his outfit.
words.ex_cn: 他穿上一身全身镜来检查自己的穿着。
words.en: Full-length is used to describe something such as a film, play, or book that is not shortened or cut in any way.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.ex: I saw him yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天看见他了。
words.en: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified.

words.tr: adj. 高的；崇高的；傲慢的
words.ex: The mountain has a lofty peak.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一个很高的山顶。
words.en: If you say that someone behaves in a lofty way, you are critical of them for behaving in a proud and rather unpleasant way, as if they think they are very important.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr: adj. 谦恭有礼的；和蔼可亲的
words.ex: He is an affable man who always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个和蔼可亲的人，总是面带微笑。
words.en: Someone who is affable is pleasant and friendly.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: He gave the rope a sudden jerk to pull it up.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把它拉了上来。
words.en: If you jerk something or someone in a particular direction, or they jerk in a particular direction, they move a short distance very suddenly and quickly.

words.ex: He danced wildly at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上疯狂地跳舞。
words.en: In a very uncontrolled or enthusiastic way.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.ex: He was thunderstruck when he saw the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜派对时，他惊呆了。
words.en: If you say that someone is thunderstruck, you mean that they are extremely surprised or shocked.

words.ex: He enquired about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了火车时刻表。
words.en: If you enquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: After a long hike, I was feeling peckish.
words.ex_cn: 长途徒步后，我感到有点饿。
words.en: If you say that you are peckish, you mean that you are slightly hungry.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.tr: adv. 吓人地; 令人恐惧地，引起突然惊恐地
words.ex: The price is frighteningly high.
words.ex_cn: 这个价格高得吓人。
words.en: In a manner that causes fear or terror.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr: adj. 无知的；缺乏知识的
words.ex: He was ignorant of the basic rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对基本规则一无所知。
words.en: If you describe someone as ignorant, you mean that they do not know things they should know. If someone is ignorant of a fact, they do not know it.

words.ex: I concur with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的观点。
words.en: If one person concurs with another person, the first person agrees with the second person.

words.ex: They danced in the ballroom last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚他们在舞厅跳舞了。
words.en: A ballroom is a very large room that is used for dancing.

words.tr: n. 戏剧表演和创作的研究或实践，戏剧性的行为
words.ex: He loves dramatics and acts in school plays.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢戏剧表演，经常参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: The art or practice of acting and stagecraft.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.ex: I went to the park with my buddy.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的同伴去了公园。
words.en: A buddy is a close friend.

words.ex: Mom reassured me that everything would be fine.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我安心，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you reassure someone, you comfort them and stop them from worrying.

words.ex: He is inordinately late for school.
words.ex_cn: 他上学迟到了异常久。
words.en: If you describe something as inordinate, you are emphasizing that it is unusually or excessively great in amount or degree.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

chapters.name: Diary of a fresher Phrases and expressions

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.tr: phrase. 出故障的；次序颠倒的；不合规定的；不适的
words.ex: The elevator is out of order.
words.ex_cn: 电梯坏了。
words.en: If something is out of order, it is not working properly.

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.tr: phrase. 前进； 进行；赞同
words.ex: The car went along the road slowly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓慢地沿着路前进。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something, especially a plan or activity; to agree with or support an idea, proposal, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.tr: phrase. 出租；租出（房屋、设备等）
words.ex: They rent out their spare room to students.
words.ex_cn: 他们把多余的房间租给学生。
words.en: To allow someone to use a property that you own in return for regular payments.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.tr: 短语动词. 突然大哭起来；忍不住流下眼泪
words.ex: When she heard the sad news, she burst into tears.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个悲伤的消息时，她突然哭了起来。
words.en: To suddenly start crying.

words.tr: 短语动词. 突然开始唱歌
words.ex: He burst into song when he heard the music.
words.ex_cn: 他听到音乐时突然唱了起来。
words.en: To suddenly start singing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 突然大笑起来；放声大笑
words.ex: He burst into laughter when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只搞笑的猫时大笑起来。
words.en: To suddenly start laughing.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

chapters.name: Extract from'Tis: A Memoir New words

words.ex: He wrote a memoir about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的回忆录。
words.en: A memoir is a book or article that you write about someone who you have known, describing what you remember of them and of particular events in which you both took part.

words.ex: Her courage in facing danger is admirable.
words.ex_cn: 她在面对危险时表现出的勇气令人钦佩。
words.en: If you say that something is admirable, you mean that you approve of it or respect it.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.ex: She looked at him admiringly.
words.ex_cn: 她钦佩地看着他。
words.en: In a way that shows you admire someone or something.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.tr:
v. 潦草地写；匆匆地写；乱涂乱画
n. 潦草的字迹；涂鸦
words.ex: He scribbled his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上潦草地写了名字。
words.en: To scribble means to write or draw something quickly or carelessly.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: She loves Irish music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢爱尔兰音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Irish means belonging or relating to Ireland, or to its people, language, or culture.

words.tr: n. 土音（尤指爱尔兰人讲英语时的土腔），（旧时爱尔兰人穿的）粗革皮鞋
words.ex: He speaks with a thick brogue.
words.ex_cn: 他说话带着浓重的口音。
words.en: A brogue is a type of shoe, traditionally a low-heeled, leather shoe with decorative perforations. It can also refer to a strong accent, especially an Irish one.

words.ex: He faced persecution for his beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他因自己的信仰而遭受迫害。
words.en: Persecution is the act of treating someone cruelly or unfairly, especially because of their race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: They persecute people for their beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他们因人们的信仰而迫害他们。
words.en: If someone is persecuted, they are treated cruelly and unfairly, often because of their race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He will surely come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天一定会来。
words.en: without doubt; certainly

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr:
n. 清教徒；清教徒似的人；主张禁欲的人； 极端拘谨的人
adj. 清教徒的；主张禁欲的； 极端拘谨的
words.ex: He lives a puritan life, avoiding all pleasures.
words.ex_cn: 他过着清教徒般的生活，避免一切享乐。
words.en: A puritan is a person who follows strict moral or religious principles, especially one who is opposed to sensual pleasures.

chapters.name: Extract from'Tis: A Memoir Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 在...外；从里面；出于；在...范围外；离开
words.ex: The ball rolled out of the box.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了盒子外面。
words.en: used to indicate movement or direction from the inside to the outside of a place or thing; used to indicate the cause or reason for something; used to indicate a lack or absence of something

words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 迷路的；迷失的；不知所措的
words.ex: He was lost in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林中迷路了。
words.en: To be unable to find one's way or to be confused about what to do or say.

words.tr: phrase. 感到迷茫的；觉得不知所措的；感到迷失方向的
words.ex: He feels lost when he sees math problems.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到数学题时，他感到迷茫。
words.en: To feel uncertain or unsure about what to do or how to proceed in a situation.

words.w: frighten the life out of sb.
words.tr: phrase. 把某人吓得半死；使某人极度惊恐
words.uk: ˈfraɪtn ðə laɪf aʊt ɒv ˈsʌmbədi
words.us: ˈfraɪtn ðə laɪf aʊt əv ˈsʌmbɑːdi
words.ex: The loud thunder frightened the life out of her.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的雷声把她吓坏了。
words.en: To scare someone very much.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人吓得要死，形容极度惊恐
words.ex: The loud noise frightened her to death.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把她吓死了。
words.en: To make someone extremely scared, to the point of fearing for their life.

chapters.name: Settling down at college around the world New words

words.ex: He lives in the dorm with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dorm is a large building at a college or university where students live.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

chapters.name: The first oyster New words

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.ex: He talked nonsense and no one understood him.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一些无意义的话，没人能理解他。
words.en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

words.ex: He was frank about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If someone is frank, they state or express things in an open and honest way.

words.ex: The weather today is nasty and rainy.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气令人不愉快，又阴又雨。
words.en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is very unpleasant, unattractive, or unkind.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.tr: n. 海产食物（如海鱼、贝类等）；
words.ex: We ate fresh seafood at the seaside restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的餐厅吃了新鲜的海产食物。
words.en: Seafood refers to fish and shellfish from the sea that are eaten as food.

words.ex: He caught a crab at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上抓到一只蟹。
words.en: A crab is a sea creature with a flat round body covered by a shell, and five pairs of legs with large claws on the front pair. Crabs usually move sideways.

words.ex: He ordered fried prawn for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了炸对虾。
words.en: A prawn is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten.

words.ex: He bought a fresh lobster at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一只新鲜的龙虾。
words.en: A lobster is a sea creature with a hard shell, two large claws, and eight legs, or the flesh of this animal eaten as food.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.ex: The child clings to his mother's leg.
words.ex_cn: 孩子紧贴着妈妈的腿。
words.en: If you cling to someone or something, you hold onto them tightly.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: The cake is yummy.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕很好吃。
words.en: If you describe food as yummy, you mean that it tastes extremely good.

words.ex: The schoolboy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那个小学生很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: A schoolboy is a boy who attends school.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: The child's innocence showed in his honest smile.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的无罪体现在他诚实的微笑中。
words.en: the state or quality of being innocent, especially freedom from sin, moral wrong, or guilt through lack of knowledge of evil

words.tr:
n. 芯片；
v. 削成碎片；碎裂；
words.ex: The computer chip is very small.
words.ex_cn: 计算机芯片非常小。
words.en: A chip is a small piece which has been broken off something larger, or a small piece of silicon used to make computer parts.

words.ex: He felt homesick after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到想家。
words.en: If you are homesick, you feel unhappy because you are away from home and are missing your family, friends, and home very much.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.tr:
v. 刮；擦；刮出刺耳声；勉强通过
n. 刮；擦；擦痕；刮擦声
words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.ex: He took a mouthful of soup.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一口汤。
words.en: A mouthful is an amount of food or drink that you put into your mouth at one time.

words.ex: They tease him because he wears funny hats.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他戴滑稽的帽子而戏弄他。
words.en: To tease someone means to make fun of them or try to provoke them in a playful way.

words.tr:
n. 绝望；
v. 绝望；
words.ex: He felt despair after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到绝望。
words.en: Despair is the feeling that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

words.ex: She bakes bread every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日都烤面包。
words.en: To bake is to cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

chapters.name: The first oyster Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.ex: To be frank, I don't like this movie.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这部电影。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is being honest or straightforward in their statement.

words.tr: phrase. 达到法定年龄；到了成年
words.ex: He came of age last year and now he can vote.
words.ex_cn: 他去年成年了，现在可以投票了。
words.en: To reach the age at which one is legally recognized as an adult.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

chapters.name: Chocolate New words

words.tr: n. 可可；可可树；可可豆；
words.ex: Cacao beans are used to make chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 可可豆用于制作巧克力。
words.en: The cacao tree is a small evergreen tree in the family Malvaceae, native to the deep tropical regions of the Americas. Its seeds, cocoa beans, are used to make cocoa mass, cocoa powder, and chocolate.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.tr: adj. 激励人的；有刺激性的；振奋人的； v. “stimulate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a stimulating talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们做了一场激励人的演讲。
words.en: Making you feel enthusiastic and full of ideas.

words.tr: adj. 有营养的； v. “nourish”的现在分词；
words.ex: This soup is nourishing and keeps you healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这汤很有营养，能让你保持健康。
words.en: If you say that food is nourishing, you mean that it is good for your health because it contains substances that help your body to be healthy.

words.ex: She added cocoa to the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她把可可粉加到了蛋糕糊里。
words.en: Cocoa is a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used in making chocolate and in cooking.

words.ex: He is highly talented.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有才华。
words.en: to a high degree or level; very

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: This book is the best-selling novel this year.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是今年最畅销的小说。
words.en: A best-selling product or book is one that many people buy.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.tr: v. 集中；浓缩；“concentrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 浓缩的；密集的；全神贯注的；
words.ex: He concentrated on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他专心做作业。
words.en: If something is concentrated, it has been made stronger or purer by removing or reducing the amount of other substances in it.

words.ex: The steam condenses into water when it touches the cold glass.
words.ex_cn: 当蒸汽接触到冷的玻璃时，会凝结成水。
words.en: If you condense something, especially a piece of writing or a speech, you make it shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

words.tr: phrase. 炼乳；浓缩牛奶（加糖并蒸发部分水分制成的浓稠牛奶）
words.ex: She added condensed milk to her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她往咖啡里加了炼乳。
words.en: Condensed milk is milk from which water has been removed and sugar has been added, making it thick and sweet.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: The popularity of this song grew quickly on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上的流行迅速增长。
words.en: The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.tr: n. 嗜食巧克力的人，吃巧克力上瘾的人
words.ex: He is a chocoholic who eats chocolate every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天吃巧克力的巧克力狂。
words.en: A person who is very fond of chocolate or addicted to it.

words.tr: phrase. 喜爱甜食的习性；爱吃甜食的人
words.ex: He has a sweet tooth and eats candy every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有甜食瘾，每天都吃糖果。
words.en: A strong liking or craving for sweet foods.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: Running releases endorphin and makes you happy.
words.ex_cn: 跑步会释放内啡肽，让你感到快乐。
words.en: Endorphins are chemicals produced naturally by the nervous system to cope with pain or stress. They are often called 'feel-good' chemicals because they can act as pain relievers and happiness boosters.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

chapters.name: Chocolate Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: Smoking has an effect on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对健康有影响。
words.en: To cause a change or influence something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……产生某种影响
words.ex: The rain have some effect on the game.
words.ex_cn: 下雨对比赛有些影响。
words.en: To produce a change or influence on something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…几乎没有影响
words.ex: The new rule has little effect on students.
words.ex_cn: 新规定对学生影响很小。
words.en: To have minimal or insignificant impact on something.

words.tr: phrase. 对…没有影响；对…不起作用
words.ex: The rain has no effect on my plan.
words.ex_cn: 下雨对我的计划没有影响。
words.en: To not cause any change or influence on something.

chapters.name: Street food around the world New words

words.ex: The wizard conjure a fireball with ancient words.
words.ex_cn: 巫师用古老的咒语召唤出一个火球。
words.en: If you conjure something out of nothing, you make it appear as if by magic.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃一个汉堡包。
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: She ate the freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了刚烤好的面包。
words.en: Recently; just now.

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.tr: adj. 不可靠的；不能信赖的；
words.ex: This clock is unreliable; it often stops.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不可靠；它经常停。
words.en: If you describe a person, machine, or method as unreliable, you mean that you cannot trust them.

words.ex: The seller gave me a receipt.
words.ex_cn: 卖方给了我一张收据。
words.en: A seller is a person or organization that sells something.

words.ex: He eats falafel for lunch every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五午餐都吃法拉费尔。
words.en: Falafel is a deep-fried ball or patty made from ground chickpeas, fava beans, or both. It is a traditional Middle Eastern food that is commonly served in a pita, which acts as a pocket, or wrapped in a flatbread known as lafa.

words.tr: n. 通勤者；经常往返者；
words.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。
words.en: A commuter is someone who travels a long distance to work every day.

words.ex: He eats a bento for lunch every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐吃便当。
words.en: A bento is a single-portion take-out or home-packed meal common in Japanese cuisine, typically consisting of rice, fish or meat, and pickled or cooked vegetables, usually in a box-shaped container.

words.tr: n. （马来西亚、印度尼西亚的）加香烤肉
words.ex: He ate satay at the night market.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜市吃了沙爹。
words.en: Satay is a dish of seasoned, skewered and grilled meat, served with a sauce.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: The soup is too spicy for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤对我来说太辣了。
words.en: Food that is spicy has a strong, hot flavor.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的； v. 改变；变化；使多样化；“vary”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The market sells varied fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售各种各样的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: If something is varied, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr: v. 描述…的特性；以…为特征；
words.ex: This book characterizes the hero as brave and kind.
words.ex_cn: 这本书将主人公描述为勇敢而善良的。
words.en: To describe the character or qualities of someone or something.

chapters.name: Thinking for yourself New words

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.ex: He looked at her with suspicion.
words.ex_cn: 他带着怀疑的眼神看着她。
words.en: A feeling or thought that something is possible, likely, or true, especially something bad or wrong, without having proof.

words.tr:
v. 阻挠；妨碍；挫败
n. 横坐板
words.ex: The rain thwarted our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨水破坏了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If you thwart someone or thwart their plans, you prevent them from doing or getting what they want.

words.ex: The organizational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: There is a dearth of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: A dearth of something is a lack or scarcity of it.

words.ex: They revere their grandfather for his wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 他们因祖父的智慧而尊敬他。
words.en: If you revere someone or something, you respect and admire them greatly.

words.tr: adj. 没有减轻的；十足的；绝对的
words.ex: The criticism was unmitigated and harsh.
words.ex_cn: 批评是全然的严厉。
words.en: If you describe something as unmitigated, you are emphasizing that it is completely bad or good, without any qualification.

words.ex: I occasionally walk my dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔在公园遛狗。
words.en: If something happens occasionally, it happens sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.tr:
adj. 有害的；恶意的
v. 中伤；污蔑
words.ex: The virus is malign and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒是有害的，并且传播迅速。
words.en: If you malign someone, you say unpleasant and untrue things about them. If something is malign, it is harmful or evil.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.tr: adj. 思春期的，有软毛的
words.ex: He is pubescent and growing taller.
words.ex_cn: 他正处于青春期，正在长高。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a person at or approaching the age of puberty; covered with short soft hairs.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.ex: He screamed in agony after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后痛苦地大叫。
words.en: Agony is very severe physical or mental pain.

words.tr: adj. 触觉的；能触知的；手感好的
words.ex: The child learns through tactile objects like blocks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通过触觉物体如积木来学习。
words.en: Relating to the sense of touch; perceptible by touch.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr: v. 使屈辱；使丢脸；使蒙羞
words.ex: He tried to humiliate her in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在全班面前羞辱她。
words.en: To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed or stupid, especially in front of other people.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: She spoke powerfully about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 她强烈地谈论了气候变化。
words.en: In a manner that is powerful; with great strength or intensity.

chapters.name: Thinking for yourself Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 独立思考；自己动脑筋判断
words.ex: You must think for yourself and not follow others blindly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须自己思考，不要盲目跟随别人。
words.en: To form opinions and make decisions based on your own judgment and not just accept what others say or do.

words.ex: He broke the vase on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something on purpose, you do it intentionally, not by accident.

words.tr: phrase. 对…评价不高；认为…不怎么样；看不起
words.ex: He does not think much of the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 他不太看好这部新电影。
words.en: To not have a high opinion of someone or something; to consider someone or something as not being very good.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 就那件事而言；而且；也；同样地
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and for that matter, I don't like tea either.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，就那件事而言，我也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to indicate that a statement applies to another subject just as much as to the one already mentioned

words.ex: He talked at length about his trip finally.
words.ex_cn: 他最后详细谈到了他的旅行。
words.en: If someone does something at length, they do it for a long time or in great detail.

words.ex: He talked at great length about his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地谈论了他的旅行。
words.en: If someone discusses something at great length, they discuss it in a very detailed way and for a long time.

words.tr: 短语. 详细地；长篇大论地
words.ex: He talked at some length about his trip to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他详细谈了他去日本的旅行。
words.en: If someone does something at some length, they do it for a considerable amount of time or in considerable detail.

words.ex: He wants to start up a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他想开一家小咖啡店。
words.en: To start up means to begin or initiate something, such as a business or a project.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，马上就要做某事
words.ex: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 我正要离开时电话响了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

chapters.name: Improve your study skills New words

words.tr: abbr. 印度联合新闻社；“United News of India”的缩写；
words.ex: The uni reported the election results quickly.
words.ex_cn: 印度联合新闻社迅速报道了选举结果。
words.en: A university is an institution of higher education and research which awards academic degrees in various subjects.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr:
n. 询问；疑问；问号
v. 询问；怀疑
words.ex: He made a query about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了公交车的时刻表。
words.en: A query is a question, especially one that you ask in order to check that something is true or correct.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: He is good at problem-solving tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决问题的任务。
words.en: The process of finding solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.ex: The workers built scaffolding around the building.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在大楼周围搭起了鹰架。
words.en: Scaffolding refers to a temporary structure on the outside of a building, made of wooden planks and metal poles, used by workers while building, repairing, or cleaning the building.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；专业的； v. “specialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a specialized job in computer repair.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作是专门修理电脑的。
words.en: Requiring or involving detailed and specific knowledge or training.

words.ex: The room is slightly warmer than before.
words.ex_cn: 房间比以前稍微暖和一点。
words.en: To a small degree; not considerably.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: The phone has a built-in camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有内置摄像头。
words.en: A built-in device or feature is one that is included as part of a larger system or structure, rather than being separate.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

chapters.name: Improve your study skills Phrases and expressions

words.ex: Well done! You solved the problem correctly.
words.ex_cn: 做得好！你正确地解决了这个问题。
words.en: Used to express approval or praise for someone who has done something successfully or achieved something.

words.ex: He is faced with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: If you are faced with a problem or a difficult situation, you have to deal with it.

words.tr: phrase. 面对，面临（困难、挑战等）
words.ex: He is faced by a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: To be confronted with a particular situation or problem.

words.ex: Believe it or not, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 信不信由你，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that may seem surprising or unbelievable.

words.tr:
n. 后续工作；后续事物
adj. 后续的；接着的
words.ex: He made a follow-up call to check on his patient.
words.ex_cn: 他打了一个随访电话来检查病人的状况。
words.en: An action or thing that serves to increase the effectiveness of a previous one, especially a second letter, phone call, or visit.

words.tr: phrase. 跟进；继续跟进某人或某事，通常用于指在会议、电话或行动后进行后续联系或行动
words.ex: I will follow up with my doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会跟进我的医生。
words.en: To follow up with someone means to contact them again in order to check something or to give or ask for more information.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 明白情况；理解意思
words.ex: Do you get the picture now?
words.ex_cn: 你现在明白了吗？
words.en: To understand or comprehend the situation or what is being communicated.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.tr: phrase. 说起来容易做起来难
words.ex: Losing weight is easier said than done.
words.ex_cn: 减肥说起来容易做起来难。
words.en: Used to say that something is easier to talk about than to actually do.

chapters.name: Thinking across cultures New words

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.tr: adv. 有系统地；有组织地；
words.ex: He systematically organized his books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 他有系统地按科目整理了他的书。
words.en: in a thorough, methodical, and organized manner

words.tr: adj. 闪米特人的；闪族语系的; n. 闪族人；闪语族
words.ex: He studies Semitic languages like Arabic and Hebrew.
words.ex_cn: 他学习希伯来语和阿拉伯语等闪米特语。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a family of languages that includes Hebrew, Arabic, and Aramaic and certain ancient languages such as Phoenician and Akkadian, constituting the main subgroup of the Afro-Asiatic family.

words.tr:
n. 阿拉伯语；
adj. 阿拉伯（语）的；
words.ex: He speaks Arabic fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地说阿拉伯语。
words.en: Relating to the Arabs or their language, culture, or civilization.

words.tr:
n. 希伯来语；
adj. 希伯来人的；
words.ex: He speaks Hebrew fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地说希伯来语。
words.en: Hebrew refers to the language, people, or culture of the ancient Israelites, or to the modern form of the language spoken in Israel.

words.tr: v. 改变（说法、决定等）；原路返回；倒回
words.ex: The algorithm backtracks when it encounters a dead end.
words.ex_cn: 该算法在遇到死胡同时会回溯。
words.en: To go back over the course by which one has come.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.tr: phrase. 罗曼语；由拉丁语演变而来的语言（如法语、西班牙语、意大利语等）
words.ex: Spanish is a romance language.
words.ex_cn: 西班牙语是一种罗曼语。
words.en: A Romance language is a language that has developed from Latin, the language of ancient Rome.

words.tr:
n. 西班牙语；
adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的；
words.ex: He speaks spanish fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲西班牙语。
words.en: Of or relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

words.ex: The stray dog wandered into the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 这只走失的狗走进了后院。
words.en: If someone or something strays, they wander away from where they are supposed to be.

words.tr: n. （Slav）斯拉夫人; adj. （Slav）斯拉夫人的；斯拉夫语的; n. （Slav）（俄...
words.ex: He works like a slave in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂里像奴隶一样工作。
words.en: A Slav is a member of any of the peoples of Eastern Europe or Russia who speak a Slavonic language.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.ex: His answer was too simplistic.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答太简单化了。
words.en: If you describe something as simplistic, you disapprove of it because it is so simple that it ignores important details or difficulties.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 有偏见的； v. “bias”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The judge was biased against the defendant.
words.ex_cn: 这位法官对被告有偏见。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.tr: adj. 修辞性的；词藻华丽的；反问的
words.ex: He asked a rhetorical question to make a point.
words.ex_cn: 他问了一个修辞性的问题来阐明观点。
words.en: A rhetorical question is one which is asked in order to make a statement rather than to get an answer.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.tr: adj. 比喻的；象征的；写实的
words.ex: He used figurative language to describe his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他用了比喻性的语言来描述他的感受。
words.en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

chapters.name: The pickle jar New words

words.tr:
n. 泡菜；腌菜；腌汁；腌制品；困境
v. 腌制（泡菜等）
words.ex: He put a pickle on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上放了一颗酸黄瓜。
words.en: A pickle is a vegetable or fruit that has been preserved in vinegar or salt water, or a difficult situation.

words.ex: The dresser helped the actress put on makeup for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 化妆师帮助女演员为电影化妆。
words.en: A dresser is a piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes, or a person who dresses in a particular way.

words.ex: He tosses the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To throw something, especially something light, with a quick, light motion.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.tr:
n. 叮当声；广告歌
v. （使）发出叮当声
words.ex: The bells make a happy jingle in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天里，铃铛发出愉快的叮当声。
words.en: A jingle is a short, simple tune, often with words, that is used to advertise a product or service on the radio or television.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.tr:
adj. 哑的；无声的
n. 哑巴；沉默的人
v. 减弱…的声音
words.ex: He stayed mute during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: If someone is mute, they are unable to speak.

words.tr:
v. 发出砰的一声
n. 重击声；砰的一声
words.ex: The book fell to the floor with a thud.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到地板上，发出一声闷响。
words.en: A thud is a dull sound, such as that which a heavy object makes when it hits something soft.

words.tr:
v. 蹲；蹲坐；擅自占住
n. 蹲；偷住的房子；蹲坐
adj. 矮而宽的；矮胖的
words.ex: He does a squat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做深蹲。
words.en: If you squat, you lower yourself towards the ground, balancing on your feet with your legs bent.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.tr:
v. 闪亮；闪光
n. 闪亮；闪光
words.ex: The sun made the knife glint.
words.ex_cn: 阳光使刀子闪亮。
words.en: If something glints, it produces or reflects a quick flash of light.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: He made a box from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸板做了一个盒子。
words.en: Cardboard is a stiff, heavy paper material that is used for making boxes and other packaging.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: He wore a big grin after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后露出了灿烂的咧嘴笑容。
words.en: If you grin, you smile broadly, usually showing your teeth.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.tr: phrase. 甜筒；冰淇淋蛋卷筒；用来盛放冰淇淋的圆锥形脆筒
words.ex: He ate an ice-cream cone at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里吃了一个冰淇淋蛋筒。
words.en: A cone-shaped wafer used to hold ice cream.

words.tr:
n. 香草；香草精
adj. 香草味的；寻常的；无特色的
words.ex: He likes vanilla ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢香草冰淇淋。
words.en: Vanilla is a flavoring derived from orchids of the genus Vanilla, primarily from the Mexican species, flat-leaved vanilla (V. planifolia). The word vanilla, derived from the diminutive of the Spanish word vaina (vaina itself meaning sheath or pod), is translated simply as 'little pod'.

words.tr: n. 客厅；起居室；营业室
words.ex: They sat in the parlor and drank tea.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在客厅里喝茶。
words.en: A parlor is a room in a house for the special use of visitors, or a room in a public building for a specific purpose.

words.tr: v. 安顿；安居；安卧；坐落于
words.ex: The baby nestles close to her mother.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿依偎在妈妈身边。
words.en: To settle or lie comfortably within or against something.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.tr:
n. 拨浪鼓；嘎嘎声；咔嗒声
v. 发出格格声；使紧张不安；喋喋不休
words.ex: The baby laughed while shaking the rattle.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝摇着拨浪鼓笑了。
words.en: If something rattles or if you rattle it, it makes short sharp knocking sounds as it moves or shakes.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.ex: He spoke eloquently about justice.
words.ex_cn: 他雄辩地谈论了正义。
words.en: In a manner that is fluent and persuasive in speaking or writing.

words.tr: adj. 关于花的；花饰的；过分华丽的；虚饰的
words.ex: Her speech was full of flowery phrases.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲充满了华丽的辞藻。
words.en: Something that is flowery is full of elaborate or literary words and phrases.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: He worked doggedly to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持不懈地工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: If you do something doggedly, you do it in a very determined way, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He put catsup on his fries.
words.ex_cn: 他在薯条上加了番茄酱。
words.en: A thick, cold sauce made from tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, and spices, used as a condiment.

words.ex: The soup was palatable after adding salt.
words.ex_cn: 加了盐后，汤变得可口美味了。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as palatable, you mean that it tastes pleasant.

words.tr:
v. 闪光；闪耀
n. 闪光；闪耀
words.ex: The dew glistens on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露珠在草地上闪闪发亮。
words.en: If something glistens, it shines, usually because it is wet or oily.

words.ex: She cuddles her baby every night.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上都拥抱她的宝宝。
words.en: To hold someone or something close in your arms as a way of showing love or affection.

words.ex: My grandchild loves to play with me.
words.ex_cn: 我的孙子/孙女喜欢和我一起玩。
words.en: A grandchild is the child of your son or daughter.

words.tr:
v. 呜咽；啜泣
n. 呜咽；啜泣
words.ex: The dog whimpered when it saw the storm.
words.ex_cn: 狗看到风暴时呜咽起来。
words.en: If someone whimpers, they make quiet unhappy or frightened sounds, as if they are about to start crying.

words.tr:
n. 尿布
v. 用尿布衬上
words.ex: The baby needs a clean diaper.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝需要一块干净的尿布。
words.en: A diaper is a piece of soft cloth or paper which is fastened around a baby's bottom in order to absorb its waste.

words.ex: He stared in amazement at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: Amazement is the feeling you have when something surprises you very much.

words.ex: He took a fistful of coins from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里抓了一把硬币。
words.en: A fistful of something is the amount of it that you can hold in your fist.

words.tr: n. 全部；全范围；全音阶；音域
words.ex: The gamut of human emotions was on display during the performance.
words.ex_cn: 表演中展现了人类情感的全部范围。
words.en: The gamut of something is the complete range of things of that kind, or a scale that includes all the notes in a musical octave.

chapters.name: The pickle jar Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 每一个的；各自的（强调全体中的每一个个体）
words.ex: Each and every student must submit their assignment by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生必须在周五前提交作业。
words.en: Every single one, without exception.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 阻止某人前进；抑制某人；使某人犹豫不决
words.ex: His fear holds him back from speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他的恐惧让他不敢在公众面前说话。
words.en: To prevent someone from advancing or progressing.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止某事物发生；抑制某物；隐瞒某事；使某人保留或不表达感情、信息等
words.ex: He held back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他忍住了眼泪。
words.en: To hold something back means to prevent something from being seen, expressed, or happening.

words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.

words.tr: phrase. 达到目的；起到作用
words.ex: This old bag still serves its purpose.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧包仍然能派上用场。
words.en: If something serves its purpose, it does what it is intended to do, even if it is not perfect.

words.tr: phrase. 就某事训斥某人；就某事给某人做长篇大论的说教
words.ex: The teacher lectured him on being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师训斥了他迟到的事。
words.en: If someone lectures you on something, they talk to you seriously or severely about it, especially in order to criticize or warn you.

words.tr: phrase. 就某事训斥或教训某人；对某人进行说教
words.ex: The teacher lectured him about being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师训斥了他迟到的事情。
words.en: To talk to someone seriously in order to criticize or warn them about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在…中起作用；参与；扮演角色
words.ex: He plays a part in solving the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决问题中发挥作用。
words.en: To have a role or influence in something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某事中起作用；在某事中扮演角色
words.ex: Exercise plays a role in staying healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康中起作用。
words.en: To have an effect or influence on something.

words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.ex: He said it was easy, but to the contrary, it was very hard.
words.ex_cn: 他说这很容易，但恰恰相反，它非常难。
words.en: If you say 'to the contrary', you are indicating that the opposite of what has been said is true.

words.ex: The children take turns to play with the toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们轮流玩这个玩具。
words.en: If people take turns doing something, they do it one after the other to ensure that each person has an equal opportunity to do it.

words.ex: To his amazement, the small dog could jump very high.
words.ex_cn: 令他惊讶的是，这只小狗能跳得很高。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens that surprises someone.

chapters.name: Relative values: Venus and Serena Williams, sisters and tennis legends New words

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.tr: n. 完美主义者；至善论者
words.ex: He is a perfectionist who checks his homework many times.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个完美主义者，会反复检查他的作业。
words.en: A perfectionist is someone who is not satisfied with anything unless it is completely perfect.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: This decision is pivotal for the company's future.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对公司未来至关重要。
words.en: Of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something else.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.ex: I am thankful for my friend's help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激朋友的帮助。
words.en: If you are thankful for something, you are pleased and grateful for it.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.tr: adj. 外向的；即将离职的；往外去的；
words.ex: He is an outgoing boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的男孩，喜欢和新朋友聊天。
words.en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.tr: adj. 直言无讳的；坦率的；
words.ex: He is an outspoken teacher who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位直言不讳的老师，总是说真话。
words.en: Someone who is outspoken expresses their opinions frankly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

words.tr:
n. 争吵
v. 争吵
words.ex: The two boys squabble over toys every day.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天为玩具争吵。
words.en: A squabble is a noisy disagreement about something unimportant.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.ex: He wears a protective helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴一顶保护性的头盔。
words.en: If something is protective, it is intended to protect someone or something from harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 散步者；流浪者；婴儿推车
words.ex: The old man takes a walk every morning as a stroller.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人每天早上都以散步者的身份散步。
words.en: A stroller is a small chair on wheels, in which a baby or young child can sit and be wheeled around.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.ex: My sibling plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的兄弟/姐妹每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A sibling is a brother or sister.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

chapters.name: Relative values: Venus and Serena Williams, sisters and tennis legends Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 回忆；回想（过去的事情）
words.ex: I think back to my childhood days.
words.ex_cn: 我回想起我的童年时光。
words.en: If you think back, you remember something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 反复地；一遍又一遍地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: If you say that something happens over and over or over and over again, you are emphasizing that it happens many times.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.ex: I think of him as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他当作朋友。
words.en: To consider someone in a particular way.

words.ex: I think of math as a tool to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 我把数学看作解决问题的工具。
words.en: To consider something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. v. 振作起来；使自己镇定；整理好自己的情绪或状态
words.ex: He needs to get himself together before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他需要在考试前振作起来。
words.en: To regain control of one's emotions or to organize one's thoughts and feelings in order to deal with a situation effectively.

words.w: be born with a silver spoon in your mouth
words.tr: phrase. 生来就有银匙在口中，比喻出生在富裕家庭，天生享有优越条件
words.uk: /biː bɔːn wɪð ə ˈsɪlvə spuːn ɪn jɔː maʊθ/
words.us: /bi bɔrn wɪθ ə ˈsɪlvər spun ɪn jʊr maʊθ/
words.ex: He was born with a silver spoon in his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他生来就家境富裕。
words.en: To be born into a very rich family and have a life of privilege and comfort without having to work for it.

words.tr: phrase. v. 没有……也勉强过；在缺乏某物的情况下生活或继续
words.ex: He went without breakfast to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他为了节省时间没吃早餐。
words.en: If you go without something that you need or usually have, you do not get it or have it.

words.tr: phrase. 当谈到某事时；就某事而言
words.ex: When it comes to math, he is very good.
words.ex_cn: 说到数学，他非常擅长。
words.en: Used to introduce a particular subject or activity that one is about to discuss or consider.

words.w: when it comes to doing something
words.tr: phrase. 当涉及到做某事时；在做某事方面
words.ex: When it comes to cooking, he always tries new recipes.
words.ex_cn: 说到做饭，他总是尝试新食谱。
words.en: When you are considering or discussing a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 某人遇到或得到（机会、事物等）
words.ex: The job opportunity came my way last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周我得到了一个工作机会。
words.en: If something comes your way, it happens to you or you get it, often without expecting it.

words.ex: He took a risk and started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒了一个险，开了自己的公司。
words.en: To do something that involves the possibility of danger, loss, or failure.

words.ex: On the one hand, I like coffee; on the other hand, I hate its taste.
words.ex_cn: 一方面，我喜欢咖啡；另一方面，我讨厌它的味道。
words.en: used to introduce the first of two contrasting points, facts, or ways of looking at something.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 储存某物；积攒某物以备后用
words.ex: He stores food up for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天储存食物。
words.en: To keep a large quantity of something for future use.

words.tr: 短语动词. 把心里的事说出来，倾诉（烦恼、秘密等）
words.ex: He talked to his friend to get it off his chest.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友倾诉，把心事说出来。
words.en: If you get something off your chest, you talk about something that has been worrying you or making you feel guilty for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；毫无疑问地
words.ex: He will come for sure.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会来。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.ex: To begin with, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: As a first point or reason; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 在比赛中；可活动的；在发挥作用；在交易活跃中
words.ex: The game is in play.
words.ex_cn: 比赛正在进行中。
words.en: Involved in a game or activity; active or operative in a situation.

words.ex: We start off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey, activity, or process.

words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.ex: What is your name?
words.ex_cn: 你叫什么名字？
words.en: You use 'what' in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

words.tr: phrase. 笑掉大牙；狂笑不止；笑到肚子疼
words.ex: We laughed our heads off at the funny movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们看那部有趣的电影时笑得前仰后合。
words.en: To laugh very hard or uncontrollably.

words.tr: phrase. 大声喊叫；拼命叫喊
words.ex: The fans shout their heads off at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 歌迷们在音乐会上大声呼喊。
words.en: To shout very loudly and for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. （对某人）大喊大叫，声嘶力竭地吼叫（通常表示愤怒或极度激动）
words.ex: The loud noise made her scream her head off.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让她尖叫得差点把头喊掉。
words.en: To scream very loudly and for a long time, often because of excitement or fear.

chapters.name: Summer camp New words

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: We sat around the campfire and told stories.
words.ex_cn: 我们围坐在篝火旁讲故事。
words.en: A campfire is a fire that is made outdoors, especially by people who are camping.
