words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: He has self-confidence when he speaks in public.
words.ex_cn: 他当众讲话时很有自信。
words.en: Self-confidence is the belief in one's own abilities and judgment.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr: n. 儿童托管；儿童保育；
words.ex: She works in childcare for young children.
words.ex_cn: 她从事幼儿托管工作。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a service or organization.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.tr:
n. 划独木舟
v. 乘独木舟；“canoe”的现在分词
words.ex: He enjoys canoeing on the lake every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每周末在湖上划独木舟。
words.en: The activity of travelling in or paddling a canoe.

words.tr:
n. 性格外向者；爱交际的人
adj. 外向的
words.ex: He is an extrovert who loves talking to people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的人，喜欢和人交谈。
words.en: An extrovert is someone who is very outgoing, sociable, and enjoys being around other people.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

chapters.name: Making the headlines New words

words.ex: The police caught the terrorist near the station.
words.ex_cn: 警察在车站附近抓住了这名恐怖分子。
words.en: A terrorist is a person who uses violent and intimidating methods in the pursuit of political aims.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr: adj. 值得纪念的；难忘的；
words.ex: That vacation was a memorable trip.
words.ex_cn: 那次旅行是一次值得纪念的旅程。
words.en: Something that is memorable is worth remembering or likely to be remembered, because it is special or very enjoyable.

words.ex: The accident was newsworthy because many people were hurt.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故很有新闻价值，因为很多人受伤了。
words.en: If something is newsworthy, it is interesting enough to be reported as news.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.tr: adj. 耸人听闻的；极好的；
words.ex: The newspaper published a sensational story about a ghost.
words.ex_cn: 这家报纸刊登了一篇关于幽灵的耸人听闻的消息。
words.en: A sensational event or situation is so remarkable that it causes great excitement and interest.

words.ex: His reaction was quick when the ball came at him.
words.ex_cn: 当球朝他飞来时，他的反应很快。
words.en: Your reaction to something that has happened or something that you have experienced is what you feel, say, or do because of it.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.tr:
adj. 受惊吓的
v. 使惊动；使惊愕；使吃惊；“startle”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was startled by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音吓了一跳。
words.en: If something startles you, it surprises and frightens you slightly.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: The project is ongoing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: An ongoing situation has been happening for quite a long time and seems likely to continue for some time in the future.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: The momentous decision changed his life.
words.ex_cn: 这个重要的决定改变了他的一生。
words.en: If you refer to a decision, event, or change as momentous, you mean that it is very important, often because of the effects that it will have in the future.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: The news has newsworthiness because it affects many people.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻有新闻价值，因为它影响了很多人。
words.en: The quality of being sufficiently interesting to be reported in news bulletins.

words.tr: n. 即时性；直接性；迫切性
words.ex: The immediacy of the response surprised her.
words.ex_cn: 回复的即时性让她感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality of being immediate or happening without delay.

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.ex: The trainee is learning how to use the machine.
words.ex_cn: 这位受训者正在学习如何使用这台机器。
words.en: A trainee is someone who is being taught how to do a particular job.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He likes apples, and similarly, his sister likes them too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，同样，他妹妹也喜欢。
words.en: in a similar way

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: Follow the guidelines to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 遵循指南以通过考试。
words.en: Guidelines are general rules, principles, or pieces of advice that help you to do something or to decide what to do in a particular situation.

words.ex: He covertly watched her every move.
words.ex_cn: 他暗中观察着她的一举一动。
words.en: In a way that is not openly acknowledged or displayed.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.tr: v. 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐丧失；削弱
words.ex: The wind erodes the sand slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀着沙子。
words.en: If rock or soil erodes or is eroded by the weather, sea, or wind, it cracks and breaks so that it is gradually destroyed.

words.ex: The power will devolve to the local government.
words.ex_cn: 权力将下放给地方政府。
words.en: If you devolve power, authority, or responsibility to a less powerful person or group, or if it devolves upon them, it is transferred to them.

words.ex: The proliferation of bacteria causes the infection to spread.
words.ex_cn: 细菌的增殖导致感染扩散。
words.en: The rapid increase in the number or amount of something.

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: He answered the question instantly.
words.ex_cn: 他立即回答了问题。
words.en: If something happens instantly, it happens immediately.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: The work is never-ending.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作没完没了。
words.en: Something that is never-ending never ends or seems as if it will never end.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

chapters.name: Making the headlines Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 成为头条新闻；登上报纸头版；引起媒体广泛关注
words.ex: The president's speech made the headlines yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲昨天上了头条。
words.en: If someone or something makes the headlines, they become well-known or important because they are reported about in the news.

words.tr: 短语动词. 成为头条新闻；引起广泛关注
words.ex: The singer hit the headlines after her surprise concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在一场惊喜演唱会后上了头条。
words.en: To become the main subject of news reports, especially in newspapers or on television.

words.tr: 短语动词. 成为新闻头条；引起广泛关注
words.ex: The big fire grab the headlines in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这场大火登上了城市的新闻头条。
words.en: To attract a lot of attention in the news or media.

words.tr: phrase. 以某事为开头；把某事作为主要内容或头条；以某事为主导
words.ex: He leads with honesty in every conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他在每次对话中都以诚实为先。
words.en: To begin something with a particular item or topic, especially in journalism where a story or piece of information is given prominence.

words.ex: He likes cats. In contrast, she prefers dogs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢猫。相比之下，她更喜欢狗。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.tr: phrase. 相比之下；对比而言
words.ex: He likes coffee. By contrast, she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡。相比之下，她更喜欢茶。
words.en: used when you are comparing two things or people and saying that the second one is very different from the first

words.ex: Many readers identify with the main character's struggles.
words.ex_cn: 许多读者对主角的挣扎感同身受。
words.en: If you identify with someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings and ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 被卷入某事中；深陷于某事中
words.ex: He was caught up in the excitement of the game.
words.ex_cn: 他被比赛的激动气氛卷入了。
words.en: To be involved in something, often without intending to be, or to be very interested in something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 被卷入某事中；陷入某事；过于投入某事而无法脱身
words.ex: She often gets caught up in her work and forgets to eat.
words.ex_cn: 她经常忙于工作而忘记吃饭。
words.en: To become involved in something, often without intending to.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: A square is by definition a shape with four equal sides.
words.ex_cn: 正方形定义上就是有四条相等边的形状。
words.en: If you say that something is true by definition, you mean that it is true because of the nature of the thing being discussed.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: He is more or less ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他差不多准备好考试了。
words.en: To a certain extent; approximately.

words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

chapters.name: The death of the newspaper? New words

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 封面价格，指商品（尤其是书籍、杂志等出版物）封面上标明的售价
words.ex: The cover price of the magazine is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本杂志的封面价格是五美元。
words.en: The price printed on the cover of a book, magazine, or other publication.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 恶性循环；无法摆脱的困境
words.ex: He keeps spending money and getting deeper in debt — it's a vicious circle.
words.ex_cn: 他不断花钱，债务越来越重——这就是一个恶性循环。
words.en: A situation in which one problem causes another problem, which then makes the first problem worse.

words.ex: The cave paintings predate written history.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画早于文字历史。
words.en: To exist or occur at a date earlier than something else.

words.tr: n. 读者（数）；高级讲师职位
words.ex: The newspaper has a large readership.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸拥有大量的读者。
words.en: The number or type of people who read a particular newspaper, magazine, or book.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.ex: The advertiser showed a new TV commercial.
words.ex_cn: 广告商播放了一则新的电视广告。
words.en: An advertiser is a person or company that pays for a product, service, or event to be advertised.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.ex: The ferocious wind knocked down the tree.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的风把树吹倒了。
words.en: A ferocious animal or person is very fierce and violent.

words.tr: adv. 冷酷地；无悔意地；毫不松劲地
words.ex: He remorselessly ignored her cries for help.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不怜悯地无视了她求救的呼喊。
words.en: Without pity or compassion; in a manner that shows no remorse.

words.ex: The company will downsize next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将裁员。
words.en: If a company or organization downsizes, it reduces the number of people it employs in order to reduce costs or improve efficiency.

words.ex: The weather bureau issued a storm warning.
words.ex_cn: 气象局发布了风暴预警。
words.en: A bureau is an office, organization, or government department that collects and distributes information.

words.ex: He reads the tabloid every morning on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公交车上读通俗小报。
words.en: A tabloid is a newspaper with small pages, usually with many pictures and short, simple reports on news events, often about famous people.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.ex: The word 'home' has a warm connotation.
words.ex_cn: ‘家’这个词有温暖的含义。
words.en: An idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal or primary meaning.

words.tr: adj. （商品或服务）价廉质次的，下品的，低档的
words.ex: The store sells downmarket clothes at low prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店以低价出售廉价服装。
words.en: If something is downmarket, it is intended for or used by people who do not have much money.

words.ex: The book has a compact design.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的设计很紧凑。
words.en: A compact object or substance is small and dense, with all its parts closely packed together.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: His smile gave me reassurance.
words.ex_cn: 他的微笑让我安心。
words.en: If someone needs reassurance, they are very worried and need someone to help them stop worrying by saying kind or helpful things.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.tr: adv. 每年地；一年一次地；
words.ex: He visits his parents annually.
words.ex_cn: 他每年去看望他的父母。
words.en: Happening once every year.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: The factory is a big polluter.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂是一个严重的污染源。
words.en: A polluter is a person or organization that causes pollution, especially one that releases harmful substances into the environment.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.tr: n. 包装材料； v. “wrap”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gift came with colorful wrapping.
words.ex_cn: 这个礼物有彩色的包装材料。
words.en: Material used for wrapping something, especially paper.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.tr:
v. 重拍；猛击
n. 重拍；猛击
words.ex: He tried to swat the fly with a newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用报纸拍死那只苍蝇。
words.en: To hit something, especially an insect, with a quick, sharp blow.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: The exploitation of natural resources helps the economy grow.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的开发有助于经济发展。
words.en: The action or fact of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work, or the utilization of something for profit or gain.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: The commentator explained the game clearly.
words.ex_cn: 评论员清晰地解释了比赛。
words.en: A commentator is someone who gives a commentary on something such as a sports event or a television program.

words.ex: He gave a dumb answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个简单的问题给出了一个愚笨的回答。
words.en: If someone is dumb, they are unable to speak. If you describe someone or something as dumb, you mean that they are stupid or silly.

words.tr: vt.& vi. 使（更）漂亮; 使（更）聪明; 变得（更）漂亮; 变得（更）聪明
words.ex: He smartened his room with new posters.
words.ex_cn: 他用新海报让房间更漂亮了。
words.en: To make something or someone look neater, more attractive, or more intelligent.

words.ex: He lost his job because of his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为正直而失去了工作。
words.en: Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.

words.ex: The judge showed impartiality in the trial.
words.ex_cn: 法官在审判中表现出公平。
words.en: Impartiality is the quality of being unbiased or not favoring one side over another.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

chapters.name: The death of the newspaper? Phrases and expressions

words.ex: The book is in print.
words.ex_cn: 这本书正在出版中。
words.en: If a book is in print, it is available from the publisher.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 使停止往前；往回走
words.ex: He turned back when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他往回走了。
words.en: To go back in the direction you have come from, or to make someone or something do this.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 提醒某人；使某人想起
words.ex: This song reminds me of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: To cause someone to remember someone or something.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.ex: He is late, that is to say, he will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，也就是说，他会错过公交车。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that makes the meaning of something clearer or gives more information

chapters.name: The press across the world New words

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: n. 宽幅印刷品（如报纸、广告等）
words.ex: He reads the broadsheet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读大报。
words.en: A broadsheet is a large piece of paper printed on one side only with information, especially news, or a newspaper that is printed on large sheets of paper.

words.ex: He is an avid reader of mystery novels.
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于阅读侦探小说。
words.en: If you say that someone is avid for something, you mean that they are very eager to get it.

words.ex: She loves Swedish meatballs.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢瑞典肉丸。
words.en: Of, relating to, or characteristic of Sweden, its people, or their language.

chapters.name: The armchair traveller New words

words.ex: The traveller visited five countries last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者去年夏天访问了五个国家。
words.en: A traveller is a person who is travelling or who often travels.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.tr: n. 愚蠢；愚蠢行为；糊涂
words.ex: His stupidity made him fail the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的愚蠢让他考试不及格。
words.en: Stupidity is the quality of being stupid or lacking intelligence.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的；令人厌烦的
words.ex: The long meeting was tiresome.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很讨厌。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as tiresome, you mean that you find them irritating or boring.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful gown to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件漂亮的礼服去参加婚礼。
words.en: A gown is a long, loose piece of clothing worn on formal occasions or by people in particular professions.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: He is pessimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持悲观态度。
words.en: If someone is pessimistic, they expect that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.tr: adj. 难以置信的；不可想象的；
words.ex: The damage from the storm was unimaginable.
words.ex_cn: 风暴造成的破坏难以置信。
words.en: If you describe something as unimaginable, you are emphasizing that it is difficult to imagine or understand because it is not part of people's normal experience.

words.ex: The dress gave her a lot of glamour.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子给她增添了许多魅力。
words.en: If someone or something has glamour, they are attractive and exciting in a way that is not ordinary.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: He walked directly to the school.
words.ex_cn: 他直接走向学校。
words.en: If you do something directly, you do it without any delay or without involving anyone else.

words.ex: He stared in astonishment at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: Astonishment is a feeling of great surprise.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.ex: The town looked unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇对他来说很陌生。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: He had a realization that he needed to change his life.
words.ex_cn: 他领悟到自己需要改变生活。
words.en: The act of becoming fully aware of something as a fact; the achievement of something desired or anticipated.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

chapters.name: The armchair traveller Phrases and expressions

words.ex: He lives alone by choice.
words.ex_cn: 他独自生活是出于自己的选择。
words.en: If you do something by choice, you do it because you want to do it and not because you are forced to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 多余的时间；充裕的时间
words.ex: He finished his homework early and had time to spare.
words.ex_cn: 他早早完成了作业，还有多余的时间。
words.en: Time that is available and not needed for a particular purpose, allowing one to do other things.

words.tr: phrase. 余钱；富余的钱；可自由支配的额外资金
words.ex: He has money to spare after paying his bills.
words.ex_cn: 付完账单后，他还有多余的钱。
words.en: Having money remaining after all expenses have been paid.

words.tr: phrase. 富余的空间；多余的余地
words.ex: The box has room to spare for more books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子还有多余的空间可以放更多书。
words.en: If you have room to spare, you have more space than you need.

words.tr: 短语. …之类的人或物；像…这样的
words.ex: I have never seen the like of such a big dog.
words.ex_cn: 我从未见过这么大的狗。
words.en: A similar type of person or thing.

words.tr: 短语. 像……这样的人或事物；诸如……之类
words.ex: He works with the likes of famous scientists.
words.ex_cn: 他与著名的科学家们一起工作。
words.en: If you refer to the likes of someone or something, you are referring to people or things of that type, especially when you are giving an example of something.

words.tr: phrase. 挤过去；奋力穿过；强行突破
words.ex: He pushed his way through the crowd to get to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他挤过人群走到门口。
words.en: To force oneself through a crowd or a difficult situation with determination.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.ex: He runs faster in comparison to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 与他哥哥相比，他跑得更快。
words.en: Used when you are comparing two things, people, or situations.

chapters.name: Duelling by folk dance New words

words.tr:
n. 决斗
v. 决斗；使（另一人）参加决斗
words.ex: The two knights prepared for a duel.
words.ex_cn: 两位骑士准备决斗。
words.en: A duel is a formal fight between two people in which they use weapons, especially in order to settle a quarrel.

words.tr:
n. 立陶宛人；立陶宛语
adj. 立陶宛（人）的；立陶宛语的
words.ex: He speaks Lithuanian at home with his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他和父母在家说立陶宛语。
words.en: Of or relating to Lithuania, its people, or their language.

words.tr: n. 矿泉疗养地；矿泉城；水疗中心；
words.ex: They went to the spa to relax and drink mineral water.
words.ex_cn: 他们去矿泉疗养地放松并饮用矿泉水。
words.en: A spa is a place where people go to improve their health and relax by having treatments such as massages and facials, and by exercising and swimming.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: The car hit a big pothole on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路上撞到了一个大坑。
words.en: A pothole is a large hole in the surface of a road, caused by traffic and bad weather.

words.ex: He told an amusingly silly joke.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个滑稽可笑的笑话。
words.en: In a manner that causes laughter or enjoyment.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: You must clean the room properly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须正确地打扫房间。
words.en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: The child looked sleepy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后看起来想睡觉。
words.en: If you are sleepy, you are tired and ready to go to sleep.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: He is a diplomatic ambassador who handles international relations.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位处理国际关系的外交大使。
words.en: Diplomatic means relating to diplomacy or diplomats, or using skill and tact in dealing with people.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: The snake has a deadly bite.
words.ex_cn: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的。
words.en: If something is deadly, it is likely or able to cause someone's death, or has already caused someone's death.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.tr:
v. 叛乱；反叛；（使）厌恶
n. 叛乱；厌恶；反感
words.ex: The people revolt against the unfair rules.
words.ex_cn: 人们反抗不公平的规则。
words.en: If a large number of people revolt, they refuse to be controlled or ruled, and take action against authority, often violent action.

words.tr: phrase. 死胡同；没有出路的情况；无法继续发展的局面
words.ex: The road is a dead end.
words.ex_cn: 这条路是死胡同。
words.en: A dead end is a street or passage that is closed at one end, or a situation from which no progress can be made.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

chapters.name: Duelling by folk dance Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 停止；停下；停止前进
words.ex: The car came to a halt at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: To stop moving or doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐停止；慢慢停下来
words.ex: The bus drew to a halt at the stop.
words.ex_cn: 公共汽车在车站停了下来。
words.en: If a vehicle or person draws to a halt, they gradually slow down and then stop.

words.tr: phrase. 刚……就……；一……就……（表示两个动作紧接着发生）
words.ex: No sooner had she arrived home than the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 她一到家，电话就响了。
words.en: If you say that no sooner has one thing happened than another thing happens, you mean that the second thing happens immediately after the first thing.

words.ex: The inverse order of the numbers is 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的倒序是5、4、3、2、1。
words.en: If there is an inverse relationship between two things, one of them becomes larger as the other becomes smaller.

words.w: be as good as one's word
words.tr: phrase. 言而有信，说到做到
words.ex: He be as good as his word and paid me back on time.
words.ex_cn: 他信守承诺，按时还了我钱。
words.en: If someone is as good as their word, they do what they have promised to do.

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （观点或态度）转变，改变主意；（身体或情绪上）恢复；顺便来访，过来
words.ex: He didn't want to help at first, but he came round after we talked.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始不想帮忙，但经过交谈后改变了主意。
words.en: To regain consciousness; to change one's opinion or position; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.ex: He said he would come, and sure enough, he arrived at 7 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他说他会来，果然，他在晚上7点到了。
words.en: As expected or predicted; indeed.

words.tr: phrase. 吵架；失和；掉落；离队
words.ex: They fell out over a small argument.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为一个小争执吵翻了。
words.en: If people fall out, they have an argument and are no longer friendly.

chapters.name: Ecotourism New words

words.ex: They go on ecotourism to protect nature.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行生态旅游以保护自然。
words.en: Ecotourism is a form of tourism involving visiting fragile, pristine, and relatively undisturbed natural areas, intended as a low-impact and often small scale alternative to standard commercial mass tourism.

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: He bought a guidebook for his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他为去巴黎旅行买了一本旅游指南。
words.en: A guidebook is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: Her skills are transferable to other jobs.
words.ex_cn: 她的技能可以转移到其他工作上。
words.en: If something is transferable, it can be moved or passed from one person, place, or situation to another.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: He checks the time on his wristwatch.
words.ex_cn: 他看下手表上的时间。
words.en: A wristwatch is a small clock that you wear on a strap around your wrist.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewellery to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewellery consists of objects that are worn for personal adornment, such as bracelets, rings, necklaces, and earrings, often made from precious metals and gemstones.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.ex: This is a good instance of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An instance is a particular example or case of something.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

chapters.name: Extract from Jane Eyre New words

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.ex: He felt deep grief after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；令人高兴的
words.ex: The garden is delightful in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，这个花园令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is delightful is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.tr: adj. 难以忍受的；不能容忍的
words.ex: The heat was unbearable.
words.ex_cn: 天气热得难以忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as unbearable, you mean that it is so unpleasant, painful, or upsetting that you feel unable to accept it or deal with it.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr: adj. 卑微的；谦逊的；虚心的；
words.ex: He lived in a humble house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他住在河边一座简陋的房子里。
words.en: If you describe someone as humble, you mean that they do not think they are better or more important than other people.

words.tr: adj. （事物或处所）没有生气的; 呆板的; 乏味的; （人）不懂感情的
words.ex: The movie felt soulless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影感觉没有灵魂，很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as soulless, you mean that they lack human qualities and the ability to feel or produce deep feelings.

words.ex: He gave a heartless reply to her plea.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的恳求给出了无情的答复。
words.en: If you describe someone as heartless, you mean that they are cruel and unkind, and have no sympathy for anyone or anything.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.ex: He believed his fate was to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名教师。
words.en: Fate is a power that is believed to control what happens in the future.

words.ex: He is entirely happy with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他完全对结果感到满意。
words.en: Completely; without exception.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.ex: He is a doubter who questions everything.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个质疑一切的怀疑者。
words.en: A doubter is a person who is uncertain or lacks conviction about something.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: He is an earnest student who always finishes his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个认真的学生，总是完成作业。
words.en: If you are earnest about something, you are serious about it and your intentions are honest and sincere.

words.ex: Her earnestness in pursuing the project was evident.
words.ex_cn: 她对项目的认真态度显而易见。
words.en: Earnestness is the quality of being very serious and sincere about something that you are doing or saying.

words.ex: He spoke with sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地说话。
words.en: Sincerity is the quality of being free from pretense, deceit, or hypocrisy.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

chapters.name: Extract from Jane Eyre Phrases and expressions

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为乐；从……中获得乐趣
words.ex: Children delight in playing with bubbles.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢玩泡泡。
words.en: If you delight in something, you get a lot of pleasure from it.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.tr: phrase. 释放某人；使某人获得自由
words.ex: The police set the boy free.
words.ex_cn: 警察让那个男孩自由了。
words.en: To release someone from confinement or obligation.

words.ex: I have faith in you to do the right thing.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你会做正确的事。
words.en: To believe in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人看来；在某人眼中
words.ex: In her eyes, he is a hero.
words.ex_cn: 在她眼里，他是个英雄。
words.en: From someone's point of view; as someone sees it.

words.ex: Don't interfere with my work.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的工作。
words.en: To interfere with something means to prevent it from happening or developing as it should, often by causing a problem or difficulty.

chapters.name: Poems New words

words.ex: He escaped from servitude and found freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他逃离了奴役，获得了自由。
words.en: The state of being a slave or completely subject to someone more powerful.

words.ex: She walked with grace across the stage.
words.ex_cn: 她优雅地走过舞台。
words.en: Grace is the quality of being pleasant, polite, and dignified, or a period of time allowed for something to be done.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.ex: He sent a card to his valentine on February 14.
words.ex_cn: 他在2月14日给他的情人送了一张卡片。
words.en: A valentine is a sweetheart chosen or complimented on Valentine's Day, or a card or gift sent on this day.

words.tr:
n. 缎子；缎子衣服
adj. 缎子似的；平滑而有光泽的
v. 对（纸等）作加光处理
words.ex: She wore a dress made of satin.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件缎子做的衣服。
words.en: Satin is a type of cloth that is smooth and shiny on one side and dull on the other.

words.tr:
v. 脱衣服
n. 裸体
words.ex: He undressed before taking a shower.
words.ex_cn: 他洗澡前脱了衣服。
words.en: To remove one's clothes.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: The chair has a wobble on one leg.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有一条腿在晃动。
words.en: If something wobbles or if you wobble it, it moves unsteadily from side to side.

words.ex: He is truthful when he speaks about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 当他谈论自己的错误时，他是诚实的。
words.en: If someone is truthful, they tell the truth and do not lie.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: He ordered a kissogram for his girlfriend's birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他为女朋友的生日订了一份吻书表演。
words.en: A kissogram is a novelty message delivered in person, often as a birthday or holiday greeting, that includes a kiss.

words.tr:
adj. 不愿分享的；占有欲强的；所有格的
n. 所有格
words.ex: The cat is possessive of its toy.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫对它的玩具很占有。
words.en: If you are possessive about something that you own, you do not like lending it to other people or sharing it with other people.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.tr: v. 刺绣；绣（花）；加以渲染（或润色）
words.ex: She embroiders flowers on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上刺绣花朵。
words.en: To embroider means to decorate cloth or other material by sewing patterns or pictures on it with colored threads.

words.tr: adj. 刺绣的，嵌入的，织入的
words.ex: The story is enwrought with mystery.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事充满了神秘。
words.en: Adjective. Decorated or embellished with something woven or worked into the fabric.

words.tr:
adj. 暗淡的；昏暗的；模糊的
v. （使）变暗淡；（使）变模糊；（使）减弱
words.ex: The room is dim because the lights are off.
words.ex_cn: 房间很暗，因为灯关了。
words.en: If a light or a place is dim, it is not bright or is not lit very strongly.

words.tr:
v. 踩；踏；践踏
n. 脚步声；胎面
words.ex: He tread carefully on the icy path.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地走在结冰的小路上。
words.en: If you tread on something, you put your foot on it when you are walking. The tread of a tyre is the pattern of lines on its surface that prevent it from slipping.

chapters.name: Love makes the world go round New words

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.tr:
n. 波斯人；波斯语
adj. 波斯人的；波斯语的
words.ex: He is a persian from Iran.
words.ex_cn: 他是来自伊朗的波斯人。
words.en: Relating to Persia (now Iran), its people, or their language.

words.ex: Traditionally, people eat rice on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 传统上，人们在新年那天吃米饭。
words.en: If something is done traditionally, it is done in a way that has been the custom for a long time.

words.ex: She works as a matchmaker for lonely people.
words.ex_cn: 她为孤独的人做红娘。
words.en: A matchmaker is someone who arranges marriages or other relationships between people, or someone who arranges matches between competitors in a sport or game.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr: n. 相亲（日本青年男女于婚前在父母陪同下互相见面的一种习俗）
words.ex: She is miai with her friend this afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她今天下午和朋友有约。
words.en: A Japanese word for a marriage interview or matchmaking meeting.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.tr:
n. 挂锁；扣锁
v. 用挂锁锁上
words.ex: He secured the gate with a padlock.
words.ex_cn: 他用挂锁锁住了大门。
words.en: A padlock is a lock which is used for fastening two things together, for example two parts of a door or a lid on a container. It consists of a block of metal with a U-shaped bar attached to it. One end of the bar is released by turning a key in the lock.

words.tr: phrase. 爱情锁；情侣锁（通常指情侣在桥上等公共场所挂上的象征永恒爱情的锁）
words.ex: Couples often attach lucchetti d'amore to the bridge as a symbol of their unbreakable love.
words.ex_cn: 情侣们经常将爱情锁挂在桥上，作为他们坚不可摧爱情的象征。
words.en: Love locks are a symbol of love and commitment. Couples lock them to a bridge or similar public fixture and throw away the key, symbolizing their unbreakable bond.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

chapters.name: Quitters are winners, Bulldogs are losers New words

words.tr: n. 轻易放弃的人；半途而废者
words.ex: He was labeled a quitter after he dropped out of the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他在马拉松比赛中途退出后，被贴上了半途而废者的标签。
words.en: A quitter is someone who gives up easily and does not finish something they have started.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: The bulldog's tenacity is legendary.
words.ex_cn: 斗牛犬的顽强是出了名的。
words.en: A bulldog is a breed of dog known for its muscular, heavy build and distinctive pushed-in nose. Bulldogs are commonly associated with courage and tenacity.

words.ex: He didn't give up, even though some called him a loser.
words.ex_cn: 他没有放弃，即使有些人称他为失败者。
words.en: A loser is someone who is not successful in a particular situation or who does not achieve what they set out to do.

words.tr: n. 喜剧演员；滑稽人物；
words.ex: The comedian made everyone laugh with his jokes.
words.ex_cn: 这位喜剧演员用他的笑话逗得大家大笑。
words.en: A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes or funny stories.

words.tr:
adj. 该死的；可恶的；糟透的
v. 咒骂（某人下地狱）
words.ex: It's a damn good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个该死的好主意。
words.en: If you say that someone is damned if they do something, you mean that they will be in a very difficult situation if they do it.

words.tr: adj. 无法实现的；难以得到的
words.ex: The prize was unattainable for him.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖对他来说是无法获得的。
words.en: If you say that something is unattainable, you mean that it cannot be achieved or is not available.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.tr: adv. 精神上；思想上；智力上；
words.ex: He is mentally strong despite his challenges.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，他在精神上很坚强。
words.en: In a manner relating to the mind or mental processes.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: The soldiers were bombarded with cannon fire.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们遭到炮火轰击。
words.en: To bombard someone or something means to attack them continuously with bombs, shells, or other missiles. It can also mean to subject someone to a lot of something, such as questions or information.

words.ex: He stayed strong through adversity.
words.ex_cn: 他在逆境中保持坚强。
words.en: Adversity refers to a difficult or unlucky situation or event.

words.ex: He always follows the maxim 'work hard, play hard'.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循‘努力工作，尽情玩耍’这一信条。
words.en: A maxim is a short, easily remembered expression of a basic principle, general truth, or rule of conduct.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: He explained the rules specifically.
words.ex_cn: 他具体地解释了规则。
words.en: You use specifically to emphasize that something is given special attention and considered separately from other things of the same kind.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.ex: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天不大可能下雨。
words.en: If you say that something is unlikely to happen or unlikely to be true, you mean that you think it will not happen or that it is not true, although it is not certain.

words.ex: He watches the Olympic games every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: Relating to the Olympic Games, an international sporting event held every four years.

words.ex: He won a medal and became a medalist.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了一枚奖牌，成为了一名奖牌得主。
words.en: A medalist is someone who has won a medal in a competition, especially in sports.

words.ex: He made a persistent effort to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他持续努力学习英语。
words.en: Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.ex: He ate too much and had indigestion.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，导致消化不良。
words.en: Indigestion is pain or discomfort in your stomach, usually after eating, which is caused by difficulty in digesting food.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr: n. 发炎；炎症；燃烧；激动
words.ex: The redness and swelling show inflammation.
words.ex_cn: 发红和肿胀表明有炎症。
words.en: Inflammation is a condition in which a part of your body becomes red, swollen, and painful as a reaction to infection or injury.

words.ex: The police caught the killer last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚抓到了杀手。
words.en: A killer is a person, animal, or thing that kills.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: He showed reluctance to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他表现出不愿意在全班面前讲话。
words.en: Reluctance is an unwillingness to do something.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 忧愁
adj.  忧郁的
words.ex: He felt melancholy after the rain stopped.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后，他感到忧郁。
words.en: A feeling of deep sadness, typically with no obvious cause.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr: n. 被动；不抵抗；消极状态
words.ex: His passivity made it hard to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的消极态度使解决问题变得困难。
words.en: The state or condition of being passive; lack of initiative or assertiveness.

words.tr: v. 再次评价；重新考虑；
words.ex: The teacher will reassess the students' projects next week.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下周重新评价学生的项目。
words.en: If you reassess something, you think about it and decide whether you need to change your opinion about it.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: The glorious sunset lit up the whole sky.
words.ex_cn: 辉煌的日落染红了整个天空。
words.en: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

chapters.name: Quitters are winners, Bulldogs are losers Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地；有限度地
words.ex: I agree with him up to a point.
words.ex_cn: 我部分同意他的观点。
words.en: To some extent but not completely.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…放弃希望或努力；不再继续支持或尝试
words.ex: After failing the test several times, he decided to give up on his dream of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: v. 在多次考试失败后，他决定放弃成为医生的梦想。
words.en: If you give up on something or someone, you stop trying to do or achieve something, or stop believing that they can succeed or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 不惜任何代价；无论如何
words.ex: He will finish the project at any cost.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会不惜一切代价完成这个项目。
words.en: If you say that something must be done at any cost, you are emphasizing that it must be done, even if this requires a lot of effort or money, or causes a lot of problems.

words.tr: phrase. 不惜任何代价；无论如何
words.ex: He will finish the project at all costs.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会不惜一切代价完成这个项目。
words.en: If you say that something must be done at all costs, you are emphasizing that it must be done, even if this requires a lot of effort or causes a lot of problems.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.tr: phrase. 从长远来看；长期地
words.ex: In the long term, eating healthy helps you feel better.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食让你感觉更好。
words.en: Over a long period of time in the future.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在中期；在学期中段；在三段论的中项位置
words.ex: The company plans to expand its market share in the middle term.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划在中期扩大市场份额。
words.en: In the middle term refers to a period that is neither short-term nor long-term, but somewhere in between, often used in planning or forecasting.

words.tr: phrase. 在短期内；从短期来看
words.ex: In the short term, we need more money to fix the car.
words.ex_cn: 短期内，我们需要更多钱来修车。
words.en: In the short term means for a brief period of time, not considering the distant future.

words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 要是……怎么办；倘若……会怎样
words.ex: What if it rains tomorrow?
words.ex_cn: 如果明天下雨怎么办？
words.en: You use what if at the beginning of a question when you ask about the consequences of something happening, especially something undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 设定一个目标；确立一个目的
words.ex: He set a goal to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他设定了每天早上跑步的目标。
words.en: To decide on something you want to achieve and plan how to achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 给自己设定一个目标
words.ex: You should set yourself a goal to read one book each month.
words.ex_cn: 你应该给自己设定一个目标，每个月读一本书。
words.en: To decide on a specific objective for yourself to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 为某人设定一个目标
words.ex: The coach set the team a goal to win the championship.
words.ex_cn: 教练为团队设定了赢得冠军的目标。
words.en: To establish a specific objective or aim for someone to achieve.

words.ex: The factory will shut down next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂下个月将关闭。
words.en: To close something, especially a business or machine, so that it stops operating.

words.tr: phrase. 从积极的一面来看；往好处说
words.ex: On the positive side, the company has made significant progress in reducing costs.
words.ex_cn: 从好的方面看，公司在降低成本方面取得了显著进展。
words.en: Looking at the good aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 从消极的一面来看；不利的一面是
words.ex: On the negative side, the project has a tight deadline and limited budget.
words.ex_cn: 从消极的一面来看，这个项目有紧迫的截止日期和有限的预算。
words.en: From a negative perspective or viewpoint.

words.tr: phrase. 在…方面；就…而言；从…角度
words.ex: He is good in terms of math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学能力方面很出色。
words.en: You use in terms of to indicate the aspect or subject that you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.ex: He earns a living by driving a taxi.
words.ex_cn: 他靠开出租车谋生。
words.en: To earn a living means to make enough money to support oneself, typically through employment or business.

words.ex: He makes a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn enough money to support oneself.

words.ex: He grew out of biting his nails when he became a teenager.
words.ex_cn: 他当了青少年后就戒掉了咬指甲的习惯。
words.en: If you grow out of a habit or a type of behaviour, you stop doing it or having it because you are older and more mature.

chapters.name: Walk your way to health New words

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He uses his brainpower to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的智力来解决数学问题。
words.en: Brainpower refers to the intellectual ability or mental capacity of a person or group of people to think, understand, and solve problems.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
